about.title: About
about.description1: I'm a developer who grew from frontend to full stack. Starting with UI/UX implementation, I've expanded my understanding to backend logic, databases, and system integration.
about.description2: I led migration and payment system development for the Incheon Wallet app and the nationwide integrated parking portal, and I pursue continuous growth by acknowledging what I don't know and staying eager to learn.
about.strength1Description: I quickly pick up unfamiliar domains and frameworks to technically implement project requirements.
about.strength2Description: I collaborate with a clear understanding of the entire flow, from frontend UI to backend APIs and databases.
about.strength3Description: I communicate smoothly with planners, designers, and backend developers to accurately grasp requirements.
about.strength4Description: I prioritize user experience, pursuing performance optimization and intuitive interface design.
